articles.title: Saskatchewan to evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies
articles.summary: The Government of Saskatchewan and utility SaskPower have announced plans to formally evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies for use in the Canadian province. Saskatchewan already has plans for the deployment of small modular reactors.

articles.title: NextEra considering new nuclear capacity
articles.summary: US utility NextEra Energy said it could add up to 6 GWe of small modular reactor generating capacity at its existing nuclear power plant sites or potential new sites, primarily to meet demand from data centres.

articles.title: KHNP seeks site for new nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has launched a bidding process to select the host cities or towns for two new large nuclear power reactors. The announcement came just days after the government confirmed plans to construct the reactors by 2038.

articles.title: Russia and Uzbekistan MoU on radioactive waste management
articles.summary: Uzbekistan's Atomic Energy Agency and Russia's TVEL have signed a memorandum of understanding relating to the development of a national radioactive waste management system.

articles.title: Type One Energy initiates licensing of fusion power plant
articles.summary: US fusion energy developer Type One Energy has submitted the initial licensing application in preparation for the construction of a fusion power plant at Tennessee Valley Authority's former Bull Run fossil plant site in Clinton, Tennessee.

articles.title: Robotisation saves 500,000 work hours, says Rosatom
articles.summary: Thirty projects to deploy robots across its machine-building division - including robotisation in transportation, welding and control operations - will save half a million standard hours of work a year,  Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom has said.

articles.title: PEJ signs first loan agreement with US export credit agency
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed a loan agreement with the Export-Import Bank of the United States, giving the Polish company greater flexibility in implementing design works planned in 2026 for the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Kursk II's first unit reaches 40% capacity
articles.summary: Pilot operation of the first unit of Russia's Kursk II nuclear power plant has begun, with the unit set to increase its output in stages over the coming months.

articles.title: Yokogawa to supply Rolls-Royce SMR control systems
articles.summary: Japanese industrial automation specialist Yokogawa Electric Corporation is to provide the data processing and control systems for the initial Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor units.

articles.title: Serbia discusses new nuclear with French development agency
articles.summary: Serbia's Minister of Mining and Energy Dubravka Đedović Handanovic has held talks with the Agence Française de Développement about cooperation related to the energy transition "especially in the development of nuclear energy applications in Serbia".

articles.title: Darlington refurb completed ahead of schedule, under budget
articles.summary: The refurbishment of the fourth and final Candu reactor at the Darlington nuclear power plant in Ontario has been completed and the unit is expected to be restarted later this month, four months ahead of schedule.

articles.title: Lianjiang simulator completes on-site acceptance testing
articles.summary: The full-scope simulator for Phase I of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant - comprising two CAP1000 reactors - in China's Guangdong province has passed acceptance tests after having been installed on-site.

articles.title: Deep Isolation launches full-scale demonstration programme
articles.summary: US nuclear waste disposal company Deep Isolation has announced the launch of its multi-year, full-scale, at-depth deep borehole demonstration programme to test its technology for safely and permanently disposing of nuclear waste deep underground.

articles.title: WANO rolls out new enhanced monitoring initiative
articles.summary: The World Association of Nuclear Operators has launched its Enhanced Performance Monitoring system for all 400+ of its member nuclear energy units, providing continuous monitoring of plant performance.

articles.title: US, Japanese partnership for fusion technology development
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy and private Japanese fusion technology company Kyoto Fusioneering have established a landmark partnership to deliver critical fusion infrastructure and perform collaborative R&D to drive down technology and commercialisation risk.

articles.title: Location of second Kazakh nuclear power plant announced
articles.summary: Kazakhstan's second nuclear power plant will be constructed in the Zhambyl district of the Almaty region - adjacent to the site selected for the country's first nuclear plant - the government has decided.

articles.title: Materials successfully tested for HTGR, says Rosatom
articles.summary: Structural components made of a carbon-carbon composite material designed for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor have passed tests at temperatures of up to 1300 degrees Celsius, Rosatom says.

articles.title: First unit at China's Taipingling plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 1 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: UK seeking pipeline of advanced nuclear projects
articles.summary: The UK government has published a first-of-its-kind framework that aims to stimulate private investment in innovative nuclear technologies – including advanced, small, and micro modular reactors – across the country, providing a clear route to market and support for credible projects to get them off the ground.
